formulas.cycle: Standard Time per Piece = this entry's own time per piece — filled in from the Part when picked, and can be changed for the day.
formulas.shift: Machine Shift Time = MOD(Machine OFF Time − Machine ON Time, 1) × 24
formulas.idealQty: Ideal Quantity = FLOOR(Machine Shift Time × 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece) — the most the shift could make, so OK + Rejected can't be more than this.
formulas.rejectedQty: Rejected Quantity = Actual Quantity − OK Quantity, so OK + Rejected = Actual. The breakdown shows how that total splits across the reasons entered on the form.
formulas.pctOk: % OK Quantity = OK Quantity ÷ (OK Quantity + Rejected Quantity)
formulas.unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, with Shift Hours and Lunch added up across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
formulas.totalStoppage: Total Stoppage = Lunch / Rest + the downtime columns opened here: Setup Time … Other.
formulas.effective: Effective Machine Run Time = (OK Qty + Rejected Qty) × Standard Time per Piece ÷ 3600 — every piece run counts on this sheet.
formulas.unreported: Unreported Time (min) = Planned Operator Shift − Effective Run Time − Total Stoppage, combined across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure.
formulas.setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
formulas.oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Total Downtime ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
formulas.oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses but lunch = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
formulas.oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses but lunch and setup time = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60 − Setup Time ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
formulas.availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Machine Shift − every stoppage; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch − Planned Down Time (the planned stops). Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
formulas.performance: Performance = Standard Time per Piece × (OK + Rejected) ÷ Operating Time, for this entry — how fast it ran against its ideal speed. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review: usually a wrong time per piece, quantity or stoppage.
formulas.quality: Quality = OK Quantity ÷ (OK + Rejected), for this entry.
formulas.review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance, Quality or any of its OEE figures (the Productivity figures, on a worker sheet) is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
